title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: workflow agent node can return generated files
summary: The briefing passes with minor corrections: the roadmap description and documented credit controls are supported, including the allocation API that the automatic check missed. Clarify the workflow billing and capacity qualifications, complete the agent-limit navigation, and remove the checklist instruction for an environment-group control absent from the table. The changed agent-node documentation still does not describe generated-file outputs.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes returning generated PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and CSV files from the workflow Agent node.
claims.quote: The Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs.

claims.claim: The planned file output works with inline agents.
claims.quote: Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents.

claims.quote: Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes the environment allocation and tenant-capacity draw rule.

$apiBaseUrl = "https://api.powerplatform.com"
$apiVersion = "2024-10-01"
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"

claims.claim: The allocation request disables tenant draw through allocatedEntitlements[].enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled false.
